title: Remove Gaming Apps
name: remove-gaming-apps
warning: Do NOT use on AMD Ryzen X3D CPUs (7800X3D/9800X3D) or if you use PC Game Pass / Xbox App.
description: Removes Xbox app, Xbox Game Bar, and Xbox Game Overlay
modal:
**When to use:** Only if you never use Xbox App/Game Pass and want to permanently remove Xbox packages.

**When NOT to use:** Do NOT use on **AMD Ryzen X3D processors** (e.g., 7800X3D, 9800X3D) since Windows relies on Game Bar for 3D V-Cache core scheduling, or if you play **PC Game Pass** games.

You can reinstall them later from the Microsoft Store.
